mapper.insert: INSERT INTO index_snapshot (snap_date, index_code, index_name, current_price, change_amount, change_rate, trade_volume, trade_amount, daily_json, updated_at) VALUES (#{snapDate}, #{indexCode}, #{indexName}, #{currentPrice}, #{changeAmount}, #{changeRate}, #{tradeVolume}, #{tradeAmount}, #{dailyJson}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (snap_date, index_code) DO UPDATE SET index_name = EXCLUDED.index_name, current_price = EXCLUDED.current_price, change_amount = EXCLUDED.change_amount, change_rate = EXCLUDED.change_rate, trade_volume = EXCLUDED.trade_volume, trade_amount = EXCLUDED.trade_amount, daily_json = EXCLUDED.daily_json, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, snap_date, index_code, index_name, current_price, change_amount, change_rate, trade_volume, trade_amount, daily_json FROM index_snapshot WHERE index_code = #{indexCode} ORDER BY snap_date DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
